title: On Hellus--Lyubeznik--Yildirim's conjecture of local cohomology modules
summary: The goal of this paper is to study the so--called Hellus--Lyubeznik--Yildirim (HLY) conjecture, that predicts the following: given a regular local ring $(R,\mathfrak{m})$, and any ideal $I\subset R$, zero is an associated prime ideal of the Matlis dual of any non--zero local cohomology module supported on $I$. Among other results, we give some partial positive answers to this conjecture in the following cases: when $\operatorname{depth} (R/I)=1$, when $\operatorname{depth} (R/I)=2$ under some extra assumptions, when $I$ is a squarefree monomial ideal inside a formal power series ring over a…
